description: A WPF app packaged with Desktop Bridge loses user settings after MSIX updates, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/61781890/cant-upgrade-settings-when-updating-a-wpf-desktop-bridge-universal-app.
prompt: Our WPF app is packaged as an MSIX and users lose their saved preferences after updates. Settings.Default.Upgrade() runs on startup, but every installed version gets a different App.exe_Url_... folder and no values migrate.
